subject: business-studies
title: Goods vs Services Adventure
welcome_lead: Some businesses sell things. Others sell help. Both count. 📦
meta_desc: Goods & Services Adventure 1 — KS3 Business Studies on the difference between goods and services.
final_note: You learned the difference between goods and services and saw examples of each.

concepts.def: Business that makes goods or services
Person who uses the goods or services

walkthroughs.body_html:
Goods are physical — phones, trainers, chocolate.

They are tangible — you can hold them.

They can be stored, shipped and resold. 📦

Services are things done for you — haircut, taxi ride, online streaming.

They are intangible — no physical product to hold.

They are also perishable — an empty cinema seat can't be sold later. 🎬

McDonald's sells goods (a burger) and services (cooking, serving, cleaning your table).

Apple sells goods (iPhone) and services (iCloud, music).

Modern businesses bundle the two. 🍔
